patch.value: Changeset-to-item traceability gate: every merged changeset references a tracked pm item or an explicit waiver, enforced in CI

AGENTS.md makes 'every code, docs, or test change must be linked to a pm item' a non-negotiable, but nothing machine-enforces it: compliance depends on agent discipline and is invisible when it degrades. Add a CI gate that extracts pm-id references from PR title/body and commit messages of a changeset, requires at least one resolvable active-or-terminal item id (or an explicit tracked waiver label), and fails otherwise. The reverse direction (which work produced a file) is pm-f86lth; this is the forward direction (no changeset lands untracked). Registers in the gate registry (pm-k6t4yb) with a negative-control fixture (a pm-id-free changeset must fail) and rides the same ratchet style as pm-kpftft. Completes the provenance half of the provable-history invariant: history proves what the tracker recorded; this proves the tracker recorded what the code did.

CI fails a changeset with no resolvable pm-id and no waiver; negative-control fixture proves the failure; waiver usage is itself a tracked, queryable event; gate registered in pm-k6t4yb with owner and failure taxonomy
Make the code-to-tracker provenance loop closed and machine-enforced
Every changeset is traversable to the work that authorized it; the graph gains evidence edges from real events instead of retrospective reconstruction
2026-07-26 ecosystem review found the forward direction of traceability unenforced while the reverse direction (pm-f86lth) and the gate infrastructure (pm-k6t4yb) are already tracked
